verdict.rationale: Netlify documents starting a project from a Git repository with auto-deploy on every push, and community users report automated builds and deploys with "no setup trouble." However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents zero-config build detection (framework, build command or publish directory inference), so the "without manual build configuration" part is only implied. missing for 10: first-party documentation of automatic framework/build-settings detection on repo connect, and hands-on evidence that a repo deploys with no build settings entered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration

citations.quote: Start a new project with an AI agent, a Git repository, or drag and drop.
Team moved off GitHub Pages to Netlify with no setup trouble and added an integrated NPM build process.
The GitHub/Slack integration, automated builds and deploys, and rewrites/reverse proxy support work great.
